challenge.better_approach: Deriving the class-only devices from cairn/devices at test time would also stop the red, but it measures the live roster and lets the launcher's own listing rule be both subject and oracle. A scratch class root measures the order over a roster the proof controls, which is the smaller and stronger change.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That bin_shortcuts reads class_root from the same CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT the launcher exports (shim.py line 318: class_root or $CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT). Read on disk; the build re-measures it by clause 1.
challenge.prior_art: 2e6c93cf74c7 wrote the order proof; 211facd306d7 made help read the class bin beside the code (which is what let codemother in). 07d73ffa129c fixed the same shape of stale expectation in test_cairn_instance_address. Grep of tickets/ and questions/ for both proof names found only those and 2772848a0e90, 69075b0e8212 (env and bash plumbing, not the roster).
challenge.real_collision: None: 2e6c93cf74c7's order (all, operator, cairn, then alpha) is kept; only the roster becomes the proof's own.

answers.falsifier: (1) over a scratch instance root holding zeta, operator, alpha and cairn and a scratch class root holding only mu, cairn help prints section headers exactly [all, operator, cairn, alpha, mu, zeta]; (2) the order proof's child env carries CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT and CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT both under its scratch home, so no live device can enter the roster it measures; (3) bin/proofs/test_help_lists_the_bin_beside_the_code_from_the_launcher.py runs green, its standing-proofs tooth included
answers.from_idea: none, because it is the red bin/proofs/test_help_lists_the_bin_beside_the_code_from_the_launcher.py sealed in commit 5ce287992, whose auto-ticket failed (cast ticket 07d73ffa129c carries the same commit)
answers.how: In bin/proofs/test_cairn_help_lists_in_the_operators_order.py: _env sets CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT=<home>/class (bin/cairn line 47 already honours it); _world builds <home>/class/mu/bin/mull, executable, first comment '# mull — mu's class-only verb', and no mu under <home>/devices; clause 1 expects [all, operator, cairn, alpha, mu, zeta]. A new tooth reads _env(home) and asserts CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT and CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT both resolve under home. No device name from the live tree is written into the proof. PROVES gains this ticket's id with clause 1 -> clause_1_sections_in_the_operators_order, 2 -> the new tooth, 3 -> a tooth running bin/proofs/test_help_lists_the_bin_beside_the_code_from_the_launcher.py green.

bullets.text: The help order proof faked instance-space only; class-space leaked the live roster in. Fix fakes both.
